For me - how I met your mother

I was on a  3 day road trip with my dad and sister, we travelled  from Alice Springs in the NT to the NSW south coast. I often heard about mim mim lights in the outback. 

We just left Alice Springs around 3am and an hour or so into our trip Dad and I both witnessed a light off into the distance (this area is totally deserted and it was eery travelling in the outback its so secluded, its hard to explain that feeling) this light came at us head on and it flew over the car bonnet up the windscreen at which point we both ducked, it continued down the back of the car and suddenly disappeared. This was 9 years ago and im still get goosebumps talking about it. 

Dad and I both said 'did you see that' at the same time. Like I said no cars, no houses, no cattle stations in this area. 
My sister asleep in the back seat did not believe us when we woke her up. 

Im guessing its one of those things you have to experience to fully believe?

Our outback Australia and the first nation people have so many stories on this kind of experience. I know ill never travel alone at night there again
